田中一郎站了起来。

他左手提着公文包，右手自然下垂，朝登机口方向走去，看路线刚好会经过孙敬文的座位。

顾承安也站了起来。

他没有快步，脚步甚至带着一点漫不经心的节奏，像是一个等烦了的旅客起来活动腿脚。

但他的路线精准地切入了田中一郎的行进方向。

五米。

三米。

两米。

田中一郎的余光捕捉到了靠近的人影，职业本能让他侧头看了一眼。

就是这一眼。

顾承安左手以极快的速度扣住对方右腕，同时右手从裤兜里掏出手铐——“咔嗒”一声，银镯子精准地扣上了田中一郎的手腕。

整个动作不超过一秒。

田中一郎的瞳孔骤缩，身体本能地要挣扎，但顾承安的左手已经用力反拧了他的手臂。

只听“咔嚓”一声，骨折了！

对方闷哼一声。

顾承安一脚踢在他腿弯，田中一郎吃不住力，身形猛地一塌。

顺势把他摁趴在地上，左腿死死压住他的脖颈。

快速把另一只手也拷上。

“别动。”

顾承安声音不大，但足够周围几排座位的人听到。

他右手从口袋里抽出证件，朝田中一郎眼前晃了一下。

“警察，你被逮捕了。”

候机区瞬间安静了一圈。几个最近的旅客愣在座位上，手里的手机和书本都忘了放下。

孙敬文这时后知后觉的也抬起头，隔着几排座位看了过来，满脸茫然。

田中一郎没有大声喊叫，也没有激烈反抗。

他费力地偏过头，斜瞪着顾承安，由于脖颈被死死压住，所以含糊地问道。

“你是…不是搞…错了什么？”他说的是标准的普通话，甚至带着一点京腔，“我是东亚…文化交流协会的——”

“我知道你是谁。”顾承安打断他的话，随即低头用只有两个人能听到的音量说，“灰鹤。”

田中一郎彻底闭嘴了。

顾承安摁断了他一只手臂，并且腿部也用上了巧劲儿，保证他很酸爽。

这小鬼子愣是不哼一声！

抗审讯训练A级，果然名不虚传。

但这不重要了。

机场安保很快赶到，两名身着制服的安检人员快步跑来。顾承安单手控制着田中一郎，另一只手再次出示证件，简短地说了一句：

“我是公安部的，这个人涉嫌危害国家安全，请协助控制现场，马上会有专人过来接手。”

Tanaka Ichiro stood up.

He was holding the briefcase in his left hand, and his right hand was naturally drooping. He walked towards the boarding gate, and his route happened to pass Sun Jingwen's seat.

Gu Chengan also stood up.

He didn't walk quickly, and his steps even had a careless rhythm, like a traveler who got tired of waiting and stretched his legs.

But his route cut precisely into the direction of Tanaka Ichiro's movement.

five meters.

Three meters.

Two meters.

Tanaka Ichiro's peripheral vision caught the approaching figure, and his professional instinct made him look sideways.

Just this one look.

Gu Chengan's left hand clasped the opponent's right wrist at an extremely fast speed, and at the same time he took out the handcuffs from his trouser pocket with his right hand - with a "click", the silver bracelet fastened onto Tanaka Ichiro's wrist accurately.

The entire action takes no more than one second.

Tanaka Ichiro's pupils shrank suddenly, and his body instinctively tried to struggle, but Gu Chengan's left hand had already twisted his arm hard.

Just listen to a "click" and it's broken!

The other party groaned.

Gu Chengan kicked him in the crook of the leg. Tanaka Ichiro couldn't bear the strength and his body suddenly collapsed.

He pushed him down to the ground and pressed his neck tightly with his left leg.

Quickly cuff the other hand.

"Don't move."

Gu Chengan's voice was not loud, but it was enough for people in the surrounding rows of seats to hear.

He took out the ID from his pocket with his right hand and waved it in front of Tanaka Ichiro's eyes.

"Police, you're under arrest."

The waiting area became quiet for a moment.Several recent passengers were stunned in their seats, forgetting to put down their mobile phones and books.

Sun Jingwen belatedly raised his head at this time and looked over from a few rows of seats away, his face full of confusion.

Tanaka Ichiro did not shout loudly or resist fiercely.

He turned his head with difficulty and glared at Gu Chengan. Since his neck was tightly pressed, he asked vaguely.

"Did you...did you...make a mistake?" He spoke in standard Mandarin, even with a bit of Beijing accent, "I am from the East Asia...Cultural Exchange Association——"

"I know who you are." Gu Chengan interrupted him, then lowered his head and said in a volume that only two people could hear, "Gray Crane."

Tanaka Ichiro completely shut up.

Gu Chengan broke one of his arms, and also used clever force on his legs to ensure that he was very sore.

This little devil didn't even make a sound!

Anti-interrogation training level A, it really lives up to its reputation.

But that doesn't matter anymore.

Airport security arrived quickly, and two uniformed security officers ran over quickly.Gu Chengan controlled Ichiro Tanaka with one hand, showed his ID again with the other hand, and said briefly:

"I am from the Ministry of Public Security. This person is suspected of endangering national security. Please help control the scene. Someone will be here to take over soon."
